description: This bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue)—across three distinct AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The horizontal axis, labeled "Different AI Models," presents the models in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," is scaled linearly from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. For each AI model, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the entropy values for each method. For GPT-4, the Baseline method has an entropy value of approximately 4.9, the Source Info method is slightly higher at approximately 5.2, and the Direct Command method is also approximately 5.0. For Claude, the Baseline method has an entropy value of approximately 4.7, the Source Info method is approximately 5.1, and the Direct Command method is approximately 4.9. For Llama, the Baseline method has an entropy value of approximately 4.6, the Source Info method is approximately 4.9, and the Direct Command method is approximately 4.8. The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are presented in the order of the AI models on the x-axis. All bars are filled with a distinct color and have a textured pattern, with no visual emphasis or annotation beyond the legend.
